comparison.objective: Pass open vials hand-to-hand over a drip tray and set them on pads; unlike commissioning a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handoff and spill-averse transport versus counterheld tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, locking torque, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Each open vial crosses above the tray and stands on its pad versus two safe stopping cycles with no hard-stop strike or drift. Spill, upright, and pad tolerances are unspecified; specs are empty.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared generically, but the record tests liquid-container transfer rather than mechanical tuning and retention.
